title: Chaind+
description: Chaind+ is a Minecraft plugin that recreates the game "Chained Together" in Minecraft: players are connected to each other with an invisible chain and must always stay close to their group.
body:
⛓️ Chaind+ – Get Chained With Your Friends!

Chaind+ brings the familiar Chained Together feeling directly to Minecraft! Connect with your friends via a chain and master challenges together – because if one falls, everyone falls. 😄

With Chaind+, you can chain with other players, and you'll be connected by a physical chain. If someone moves too far away, they'll be pulled back – so teamwork is essential!

🔗 Features:

⛓️ Chain players together – connect with your friends
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Multiplayer chains – multiple players can be connected simultaneously
📏 Distance limit – if a player moves too far away, they'll be pulled back
⚡ Simple command system
🛠️ Configurable settings

🎮 Perfect for challenges, parkour, or events
